Consequently, the simple lateral-force limit at that port is 166.7 N, not 250 N.

A 100 N inspection load there consumes 60% of the external reference envelope. The model separately includes head gravity, its eccentricity, 10 N of guide-force allowance and 0.5 N·m of parasitic central bending.

The intended application is a stationary inspection or light maintenance fixture on a nearly vertical wall. Intentional torsion, impact, sustained vibration and deliberate external compression are outside this construction’s rating. It is not a drilling-reaction fixture or climbing-robot anchor.

Feet that can actually share load

Each foot uses a keyed, nonrotating post and two guide bushings. A freely swiveling shoe would create its own rocking problem under shear.

The candidate pad is a mechanically captured 1 mm ether-polyurethane sheet. The manufacturer’s material data identify an obtainable material family, but do not establish its friction, installed stiffness or 24-hour creep on masonry. 
us.misumi-ec.com

Each foot has an independently adjustable spring seat. A proposed six-disc stack—three series stages, with two discs in parallel per stage—provides compliance and a measurable force witness. The adjustment must not rotate the loaded pad against the wall.

The important correction is:

A total clamp reading of 580 N does not establish four useful foot forces.

Unequal stiffness or height can overload one foot while another has little friction capacity. The model therefore requires individual force initialization and bounded installed stiffness, including the actual wall contact.
